Vision and Mission
Vision: To provide affordable quality higher education through need based curriculum to students of all sections of society and help them to acquire knowledge, skill and value so as to make them empowered, innovative and socially conscious human resource, fully competent to face all the challenges of the changing world and contribute significantly for the qualitative change of life of people of the world.
Mission: To foster all round development of students as well as neighbourhood by providing quality education and developing skill for entrepreneurship and self employment to compete with the present day world and future. Efforts will also be made to generate new ideas as for benefit of society and to train people to work in the fields where they will be valued for their ability to work.

About Us
Chandra Kamal Bezbaruah College, Teok is located by the side of the National Highway No. 715 at about 25 Kms. east of Jorhat town. The word Teok comes from the Tai language which means abundance of milk and ghee. This large belt of the eastern part of Jorhat district is mostly inhabited by small agriculturalists and tea garden labourers. A large part of the population of neighbouring areas of the college belongs to Scheduled Castes and Plain Tribe of the Mising community. C.K.B College, Teok is almost at an equidistance from Jorhat and Sivasagar. It is well connected by bus from both the towns. Three sides of the college are surrounded by beautiful tea gardens. The college has about 100 bighas (approximately 33.33 acres) of land out of which about 35% land is covered by valuable trees. Thus, the natural environment of the college can be compared with an ancient Indian Ashram.
In the year 1959, at the initiative of a few distinguished educationists and with the active co-operation of the people of the locality C.K.B. College, Teok was established as ‘Teok Purbanchal College’. Later, in 1961 the college was renamed as Chandra Kamal Bezbaruah College. Chandra Kamal Bezbaruah was a very courageous pioneer tea planter of Assam and a protagonist of education. His benevolent sons Late Dr N.K. Bezbaruah and Late R. K.  Bezbaruah donated about 100 bighas of land and a substantial amount to construct the college in the initial years. C.K.B. College, Teok is a co-educational institution offering courses in both Arts and Commerce Stream. The Arts stream of the college was brought under deficit system in the year 1972 and the Commerce stream in 1996. At present the college community consists of 1500 students, 34 permanent Associate/Assistant Professors, 14 teachers appointed on adhoc basis and 13 non- teaching employees. The college at present has 8 departments

Department of Assamese
The department of Assamese is one of the major departments of C.K.B. College, Teok which offers courses in both H.S and U.G. The department was established in 1959. Since its inception in 1959, the Department of Assamese has been successfully disseminating teaching, learning, evaluation, research and extension activities in Assamese Language and Literature. The department at present imparts under graduate programme in the form of Major and General Courses in Assamese along with Assamese as Modern Indian Language (MIL). The Department has been working with a band of dedicated teachers since its inception in 1959. The department has been striving for literary, linguistic & cultural preservation through seminar, workshop, popular talks and various activities ever.
Learn More
Department of Economics
The Department of Economics C. K. B. College, Teok was established in the year 1959 at the same year of the establishment of the college. Since establishment, the department has been offering the course in pre-degree level and as non-honours in the undergraduate level affiliated to Dibrugarh University. Major course in this subject was formally introduced in the year 1974. MISSION AND VISION OF THE DEPARTMENT The department’s aim is to provide quality education to the students through need based curriculum in economics and make them socially responsible human being through proper guidance and make them aware about changing challenges of new world in the field of economics as well as other relevant subjects .
Learn More
Department of Education
Department of education as a discipline of study has great significance particularly in the context of our national effort to eradicate illiteracy through several locale and national programme. All these efforts require massive manpower initiated to learning and teaching technique and the manpower need can be fulfilled by this discipline. The department of education C.K.B College, Teok was started with the beginning of the college in 1959. Introduction of major course in the department was from 1984.
Learn More
Department of English
The Department of English, C. K. B. College, Teok is one of the major departments of the college which offers courses both in Higher Secondary and Undergraduate level. The Department was established in the same year (1959 ) the college was established. During that time, Non -Major courses were taught upto Degree 3rd year but from the academic year 2003 -04, English Major was introduced along with Degree General course . Since the academic year 2019-2020 the Department has been offering English Honours in the CBCS system. Late Jogendranath Bhuyan, was the founder Head of the Department of English. At present Dr.Moyuri Chetiya is the Head of the Department.
Learn More
Department of History
The Department of History was established in the year 1959 CE with Late Punaram Gogoi as the Founder Teacher. The department has been enriched by the relentless dedication and services of the early teachers like Late Sibaram Bora, and Late Umacharan Hazarika. In 1982 CE, the Major courses were formally introduced for the students of the department, and teachers like Shri Liaquat Ahmed, Shri Arup Kumar Borthakur, Late Dr. Ranjit Ranjan Saikia, and Late Prantanu Thakur built on the foundations laid by the founder teachers. The Semester system was introduced in 2011 CE and the CBCS courses were started from 2019 CE respectively.
Learn More
Department of Political Science
The Department of Political Science of Chandra Kamal Bezbaruah College, Teok is one of the premier departments of the College. The department is imparting higher education to the people of Teok Revenue Circle since the establishment of the College in 1959. Affiliated to the Dibrugarh University offering Honours courses, the teachers and students of the Department have brought laurels to the community since the year 1965-1966. Couple of alumni of the department is engaged in responsible positions in Government and Non-Government Sectors. A few of them are faculties in Colleges as well. The Political Science is one of the most sought after discipline of study in the College. This year 98 students have enrolled in the department as Honours student. Almost 150 students are pursuing Under Graduate CBCS Honours course in the discipline at present. Nearly 200 students are pursuing the Generic Elective Course of Political Science.
Learn More
Department of Sociology
The Department of Sociology,CKB college,Teok was started in HS course in 1997, under graduate General course in 1999 and Major Course in 2005. Since then the Department has been offering Major/ Honours and non-Major Course in this subject. Presently the Department has two Permanent teachers and one part time teachers, Ms. Nizara Baruah (HoD)Pranab kumar Saikia ,Ms.Mayashree Buragohain. (Adhoc). The facilities are always being dedicated and sincere to Their duties and responsibilities in academic,curricular and PO- curricular activities. Students are admitted in Honours on the merit basis. With the growing demand of aspiring Students to pursue graduation in this subject, the Department has increased the allotment of seats. The Department also follow the govt. reservation policy in the admission process. Course offered:BA Regular: The college is affiliated to the Dibrugarh University.Hence, the college has follow the prescribed Syllabus of Dibrugarh University. Presently ,the CBCS system has been introduced from 2019.

Department of Commerce
The B.Com. Course started from 1982-83 with Accountancy as Honors Subject with a Specialization in Accounting and Finance, the department aims to boost students’ overall performance, personality development, moral character, entrepreneurship development, etc., so that they can become employable, self-sufficient, and a good citizen. The Department of Commerce provides a healthy infrastructure to the students for improving their practical knowledge and expertise to suit the modern and fast-changing world.l
